egg-fine-first-dynamic-matrix-audit-v1.limitations: The producer's real code1 metadata-serialization failure is retained. This does not assert raw-file identity or accept a physical state.

egg-cad1920-bordered-metis-candidate-v1.scope: Resolve matched original two-jaw controls on declared CAD or fixed-polyhedron egg geometry.
egg-cad1920-bordered-metis-candidate-v1.limitations: Original actual finger geoms, physical held points/components, material/density, friction, actuation, timestep and force budgets are preserved. CAD and polyhedral models have their explicitly measured different represented volume/mass. Five states are a short diagnostic, not a complete application/history or converged contact reference. Every saved state still requires independent force/global-field auditing. Geometry, bulk, contact integration and regularization axes, models/feedback and verified accuracy/cost remain open.

egg-cad1920-bordered-metis-audit-v1.scope: Independently verify every precision-aware spatial state and its unaveraged global field.
egg-cad1920-bordered-metis-audit-v1.limitations: Every original dynamic step is independently reconstructed, including exact previous-state/velocity integration, unsmoothed centered normal/friction stencils, mass/armature and capped jaw PD. Raw global wide-coordinate field bounds remain visible. The original fixed-arm/two-jaw control and saved held initializer remain explicit. Full-arm application matching and physical spatial/contact/geometry convergence are separate incomplete requirements.

egg-cad1920-bordered-metis-fields-v1.scope: Compare all saved paired-reference arrays and full stress fields without a new solve.
egg-cad1920-bordered-metis-fields-v1.limitations: Complete saved histories are compared at identical physical inputs and byte-identical geometry. By default initializer bytes must match; the explicit resolved-initializer option instead checks every initializer array at the original state budget and retains its measured difference. Independent force-audit results are checked and retained, not reassembled in this field comparison. This proves numerical equivalence only for these saved states; it establishes neither physical convergence nor a controlled timing improvement or warmed production cost.

limitations: All14 closed attempts retain actual successful/failed wrapper codes, scheduler accounting and closed sources. Both numerical candidates pass all five original coarse states, independent original force gates and complete corner/quadrature tensors before fine factorization. The exact fine Schur linear solve is not an accepted nonlinear physical state, a convergence result, a proven diagnosis of the internal MemoryError, a controlled speedup or warmed production cost. Distinct nonsymmetric coupling blocks are retained; no coefficient pruning or physical regularization is added. Failed capture metadata and measured long-double padding differences remain explicit. Full A/B/C physical/model/island/feedback/cost requirements remain open. Files of at least50MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original file exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
